title: I vibe-coded a 3D roguelike deckbuilder twist on Connect 4 using Three.js, a Negamax AI solver, and a zero-asset 8-bit Web Audio synth (Playable in browser)
author: Comfortable_Goat4745
selftext:
Howdy, y'all! I built Connect 4: Subterranean Ascension to see how far I could push a modular browser game with zero external audio or 3D model files—everything from the 3D cavern board to the chiptune soundtrack is generated procedurally in code.

Honestly, I'm just looking for any type of feedback at all. I'm starved for some genuine critiques out here.

🗳️ VibeTopList Page (Votes appreciated!): [https://vibetoplist.com/listing/connect-4-subterranean-ascension](https://vibetoplist.com/listing/connect-4-subterranean-ascension)
